selection: Existing configuration key Providers:UseDeterministicTestAdapters (owner decision B0-5); no other mode switch

methods.ResolveCandidate: Implemented: pre-acceptance query, bounded retries (Offer:RetryCount/RetryInterval), deadline Offer:RequestTimeout seconds

bindings.normalization: Conservative single OfferPackage item, one AirTransport service per ticket coupon, Opaque fare construction, NotSupplied offer/price/ticketing validity, infants refused (OD-S1-07); a percentage charge row is valued from its sale-currency equivalentAmount and rejected when it supplies none (OD-S1-08)
bindings.certification: NOT_CERTIFIED for real effects (LIVE_ACCEPTANCE_BLOCKED(BD-001), uncertified fulfillment profile OD-S1-07); LIVE_CANDIDATE_PROVEN on 2026-09-18 against http://localhost:5095 with a real priced offer (E2E/LIVE-AIROFFER-RUN.txt, payload E2E/airoffer-live-details.json, digest f00010dadcf1ea25d8fae853c40ae22650d3554769231c239b2f907196979611)

bindings.active: Providers:UseDeterministicTestAdapters = true (replaces the real binding; rejected at startup in Production)
bindings.store: Independent database ConnectionStrings:DeterministicOwnerDbContext, schema DeterministicOwner (ReferenceOffers, OwnerReads, OwnerAvailability)

methods.ResolveCandidate: Bound candidate visible only to its owner/customer/channel/office; every read recorded in OwnerReads
methods.ReadBoundCandidate: Implemented against the stored binding and payload digest

bindings.certification: Reference simulator; attests target-contract tests only, never the real AirOffer
